items:
About this space

STEPS to Camp WaterColor! Right across from the playground!

6-Seater LSV & 6 bikes included complimentary!

A STUNNING spacious home with a PRIVATE POOL, fire pit, gym, ping pong table, outdoor kitchen, detached carriage house, and private courtyard!

Gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, Sonos speakers, and MULTIPLE screened-in porches! 6 En-suite bedrooms, a bunk room, plus a separate apartment above the garage with its own living room + kitchenette + washer/dryer!

The space

Welcome to 'WaterColor Masterpiece!'

A brand new 6-seater LSV + 6 Taxi bikes included complimentary! About a $250/day value!

This home can sleep up to 22 guests, and is packed with top-notch amenities for an unforgettable stay! With multiple porches, a private courtyard, loaded with board games, an exercise room, and a heated pool, you'll have plenty of space to relax and have fun! You're also directly across from Camp Watercolor and the WaterColor playground- literally right outside the front door!

Upon entering you will be greeted with 12' ceilings, wood panel walls, and French doors that open to the private courtyard with heated pool, fire pit, and summer kitchen. The gourmet kitchen includes a 48" Wolf gas range with retractable hood, 42" Sub Zero refrigerator, ice maker, and wine fridge. This home also features an insta-hot water heater, and window shades on every window and door. The property also has Sonos surround sound throughout, including by the pool!

The home offers 5 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms plus a bunk room that sleeps 8. There is also an additional half bathroom, a gym with 2 Pelotons, an office, a den, and 2 service bars. The 2 master bedrooms (one on 1st floor, one on 2nd floor) both feature a King-sized bed, walk-in closet, and a private bathroom with double vanities! Also, five of the bathrooms in this home are equipped with little kids' stools to make it easier for young children to reach the sink.

On the second floor, you'll find a second living area (den) with a sofa bed and PlayStation 4, plus 3 more bedrooms. There is a washer/dryer on the first floor and second floor of the main house, and also in the carriage house for all your laundry needs!

Traveling up to the third floor is where the bunk room is located, including 2 triple Twin bunks (Twin over 2 Twins) and 2 separate Twin beds. Also on this floor is a private full bathroom with double vanities and a shower/tub combination.

This home also includes a separate carriage house with a living room with a sleeper sofa, kitchenette, dedicated workspace, washer/dryer, Queen bedroom, and full bathroom with a shower/tub combination.

There is a ping pong table in the garage, as well as books/games throughout the home for extra entertainment!

Directly across the street from Fern Park and Camp Watercolor, you're close to 3 resort-style pools, slides, a lazy river, food/drinks, beach access, and more! Also conveniently located near other restaurants, shops, and Publix, this home is ready for your next beach adventure!

This house comes with a maximum of 14 wristbands, which per the WaterColor HOA limits the number we accommodate even though there are sleeping arrangements in the home for more. Children under 5 are not required to wear a wristband so are not included in this number.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 22 Guests):

FIRST FLOOR
-Master King Bedroom with en-suite bathroom with double vanities, glass shower, walk-in closet
-Exercise Room
-Office
-Living Room (air mattress if needed)
-Kitchen
-Dining Room
-Laundry Room 1
-Half Bathroom

SECOND FLOOR
-Master King Bedroom with walk-in closet, 2 balcony accesses (1 private and 1 shared), + en-suite bathroom with double vanities, soaking tub, separate glass shower
-Guest Bedroom w/ King bed, walk-in closet, balcony access, and en-suite bathroom with shower/tub combo
-Guest Bedroom w/ King bed + en-suite bathroom with glass shower (also accessible from the hallway)
-Den w/ Sleeper Sofa and a PlayStation 4
-Laundry Room 2

THIRD FLOOR
-Bunk Room with 2 sets of triple bunks (Twin over Twin & Twin) and 2 additional separate Twin beds, + en-suite bathroom with shower/tub combo (sleeps 8)

CARRIAGE HOUSE
-Guest Room with Queen bed
-Full Bathroom with shower/tub combo
-Living Room with Sleeper Sofa
-Kitchenette
-Dedicated Workspace
-Washer/Dryer 3

There is also a pack n' play provided at the home for your use if needed.

Guest access

Camp WaterColor is literally steps from the home, making it a dream to not have to worry about parking! The Beach Club is about a 5 minuteLSV ride. The ultra desirable location of this home cannot be beat especially for families!!!

Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for littler kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground.

The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an 'adults only' pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf!

These accesses are included in the nightly rate and are no additional charge to the guests.

Other things to note
-Beach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance.
-In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your travel group when booking. Please bear in mind that the HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here. Finally, the WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration.
-Please note we provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay.
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. These times are strict and late check out may be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Smoking is prohibited.
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian.
-LSV is not to be driven past the town of Seagrove to the East or the town of Grayton Beach to the West. Resolving any issue from the LSV battery dying because of the renters not charging it will be charged to the renters.
-Pool heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation and is available October 1 - April 30.
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by bikes, pool, LSV, fire pit, or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response:
Thank you for your thoughtful review! We're so glad to hear that the home and its proximity to Camp Watercolor worked well for your family. It sounds like the front porch swing was a perfect spot to relax while watching the kids enjoy the playground!

Regarding the supplies, we do provide a starter set of essentials, as outlined in our listing and arrival information. However, we are always happy to provide more items upon request to ensure your stay is as comfortable as possible. We appreciate your feedback and will continue to prioritize guest satisfaction. We would love to welcome you back again soon!

reviews.text: We have young kids and wanted to try staying close to Camp Watercolor this year. It was perfect! Loved being able to watch them play on the playground from the front porch swing. House was clean, spacious, and very well maintained. Not much sun on the pool unfortunately. I really wish the management company would provide basic supplies (enough toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dish soap, laundry detergent, salt and pepper). It's really a small annual cost when you're renting a property for over $2k/night. I would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.author: Morgan W.
reviews.label: Good

responses.response: Thank you so much for your thoughtful review! We’re thrilled to hear the home, pool, and location were such a great fit for your family. We also truly appreciate your feedback and wanted to share that since your stay, we’ve done a complete walkthrough of the home and have replaced the dishwasher to ensure everything is in perfect working order. For future guests, we do send out all arrival details ahead of time (including house code, bike info, and address), and there’s also a house book inside the home with even more helpful information for your stay. We’re so glad you still had a fantastic experience overall and would recommend the property — we’d love to welcome you back anytime!

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The house was absolutely perfect for our family, and the pool was a huge hit. The location couldn’t have been better — truly ideal for everything we wanted to do.There were a few minor hiccups: we had to reset the breaker to use the dishwasher and the third-floor lights, and the check-in instructions weren’t very clear about where to find the key. Accessing the bikes was a bit confusing at first and took some time to sort out, and the golf cart didn’t appear to be checked before our arrival.Based on the nightly rental rate, we would have appreciated a warmer welcome from the home — things like clearer instructions, a quick property check, or small thoughtful touches would have gone a long way.That said, none of these issues impacted our overall experience — they were just small annoyances. We had a fantastic time and would absolutely recommend this property to any family or large group!
